description: Source code implementing iterator functions for reftable data structures, including seek, next, and close operations for various iterator types.

methods.name: iterator_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific record in the iterator.

methods.name: iterator_next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next record.

methods.name: iterator_set_empty
methods.description: Sets the iterator to an empty state.

methods.name: filtering_ref_iterator_close
methods.description: Closes a filtering reference iterator and releases resources.

methods.name: filtering_ref_iterator_seek
methods.description: Seeks within a filtering reference iterator.

methods.name: filtering_ref_iterator_next
methods.description: Retrieves the next filtered reference record.

methods.name: iterator_from_filtering_ref_iterator
methods.description: Initializes an iterator from a filtering reference iterator.

methods.name: indexed_table_ref_iter_close
methods.description: Closes an indexed table reference iterator and releases resources.

methods.name: indexed_table_ref_iter_next_block
methods.description: Advances to the next block in an indexed table reference iterator.

methods.name: indexed_table_ref_iter_seek
methods.description: Seek operation not supported for indexed table reference iterator.

methods.name: indexed_table_ref_iter_next
methods.description: Retrieves the next reference record from an indexed table.

methods.name: indexed_table_ref_iter_new
methods.description: Creates a new indexed table reference iterator.

methods.name: iterator_from_indexed_table_ref_iter
methods.description: Initializes an iterator from an indexed table reference iterator.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_destroy
methods.description: Destroys an iterator and releases resources.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_seek_ref
methods.description: Seeks to a reference by name.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_seek_log_at
methods.description: Seeks to a log record at a specific update index.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_seek_log
methods.description: Seeks to the latest log record.
